items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Alex used to play with me.

ctx.x: Yeah, trumpet player. He had the two-lane band, the brass band. All the dog fellas. And his nephew, Alex Scott. He was a very good bass player. Very good. Very good.
Alex used to play with me. Alex used to play with me.
I knew you didn't talk about Jimmy Pauline. Oh, yes. Yes. And Spencer. Wow.
